payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether footnote *10 limits (27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L) govern each Federal FY2025 evaluation period that falls on or after the permit effective date and within three years of that date, rather than footnote *11 limits or no applicable numeric limit. The packet establishes the temporal applicability rules for *10 (effective date through three years thereafter) and *11 (beginning three years after effective date through permit expiration/continuation), and it identifies the distinct numeric limits tied to each footnote. However, the packet does not state the permit effective date, does not identify any specific evaluation-period dates within FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30), and does not supply permit expiration or continuation facts needed to test overlap with the *11 window. Without those dates, it cannot be established that FY2025 evaluation periods fall within the *10 window (supporting ACCEPT), nor that they fall outside it into the *11 window or a gap with no numeric limit (supporting REJECT). Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure; neither adjudication burden is met.
